name: Zodwa and the Quarter Kota Mystery
shortDescription: Zodwa turns an ordinary school lunch into a fractions mystery when she notices that one 'quarter' kota is smaller than another.
longDescription: At Siyafunda Primary School, Zodwa notices that Jabu's kota is larger than hers even though both were sold as quarter loaves. With Jabu and Nomsa, she compares the portions and discovers that a true quarter must be one of four equal parts, while Mr Mkhize has been cutting each loaf into five smaller pieces. The children use maths, observation and respectful problem-solving to stand up for fair portions, honest pricing and better business practices.
